# Sample EQ Reference Vectors

These three vectors consolidate the existing Sample payload regression values.
They are stored signed Q13 coefficients in `b1,b2,b0,-a1,-a2` order, not values
generated by the tests. Both native and Python tests consume this file.

The neutral and high-shelf cases require byte-exact output. Frequency 27 permits
one Q13 unit per coefficient, reflecting observed final quantization. This
tolerance applies to regeneration only; preservation always requires exact bytes.

Further shelf boost/cut and boundary vectors are awaiting independent validation.
Do not add calculated candidates as if they were independently measured values.
